column1: # TITLE: Exon expression for NCI small cell lung cancer cell line panel
# SUMMARY: Characterization of 63 small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cell lines and a comparator set of non-small cell lung cancer and normal counterpart cells
column3: gene expression profiling and microRNA expression profiling have been completed. Data and tools for searching these data will be made publicly available through the NCI Developmental Therapeutics Program at http://SCLC.cancer.gov. SCLC is an aggressive
column4: recalcitrant cancer and have seen limited treatment advances in the last 30 years. Drug sensitivity data coupled with the transcription and microRNA profiles of a cohort of SCLC cell lines may help define novel treatment paradigms.
